Class InitialTransition

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLTransition
sysmlinjava.states.InitialTransition
public final class InitialTransition extends SysMLTransition
SysMLinJava representation of the initial transition of a SysML state machine, i.e. of the transition from the initial state to a state of the state machine. The InitialTransition must be the first transition to occur for all state machines.

The SysMLStateMachine execution commences with the performance of this transition to a state of the specialized state machine. The InitialTransition is triggered by the InitialEvent and has no guard nor effect. It's initialization must specify the instance of the InitialState specified in the SysMLStateMachine and a specified next state to transition to. An example follows. 

   public void createTransitions()
   {
           :
       initialToPowerOff = new InitialTransition(context, initialState, powerOffState, initialToPowerOffEffect, "InitialToPowerOff");
           :
   }

      public InitialTransition(Optional<? extends StateBehaviorContext> context, SysMLInitialState initialState, SysMLState nextState, SysMLEffect effect, String name)
      Constructor for initial transition to a state with an effect.
